source.manualTitle: Whirlpool/KitchenAid ACU French Door Refrigerator (W11509412A, ~27 cu ft)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered at step 01. Press SW5/SW4 to navigate to the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW5 to move to the next step in the sequence. Press SW4 to back up.

steps.title: Navigate to Service Test 36
steps.body: In Service Diagnostics Mode, press SW5 to advance until the dispenser display shows 36. Press SW4 to go back. Amber Order Filter = step number; red Replace Filter = step result.

steps.title: Toggle ice box fan
steps.body: Press SW3 to control ice box fan. Temp display: 01=on, 02=off. Verify airflow from ice box fan (3500 RPM spec).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW3 to control ice box fan. Temp display: 01=on, 02=off. Verify airflow from ice box fan (3500 RPM spec).

steps.title: Ice box fan operation
steps.body: With display 01 (fan on), is airflow present from the ice compartment fan?
steps.sourceExcerpt: With display 01 (fan on), is airflow present from the ice compartment fan?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Ice box fan does not run — check P8-5/P8-4 harness and 12.7 VDC supply.

steps.title: Replace ice box fan
steps.oemOutcome: Replace ice box fan motor when it does not run in service test 36.

steps.title: Ice box fan verified
steps.oemOutcome: Ice box fan operates correctly in service test 36.
